gloss: to babble; to talk nonsense; to mouth off

definitions.gloss: to babble; to talk nonsense; to mouth off
definitions.explanation: A derogatory verb meaning to say something, implying the speaker finds it foolish or annoying. Often used to dismiss what someone else has said.

examples.japanese: くだらないことをほざくな。
{何|なに}をほざいているんだ。
{生意気|なまいき}なことをほざくな、この{野郎|やろう}。
examples.english: Don't mouth off with that cocky attitude, you jerk.

notes:
REGISTER:
This is a rough, derogatory word. It's often used when the speaker is angry or dismissive of what someone else is saying. Common in confrontational speech and media.

USAGE:
・〜をほざく - to spout/babble (something)
・ほざくな - shut up, stop spouting nonsense
・{何|なに}をほざいている - what are you blabbering about

COMPARISON:
・ほざく - to babble, mouth off (derogatory)
・{言|い}う - to say (neutral)
・しゃべる - to talk, chat (casual)
・{吠|ほ}える - to bark, to yell (also derogatory when about speech)

NOTE:
Very informal and can be considered rude. Mostly heard in fiction, arguments, or when expressing strong irritation.
